about: Notes to Google Drive: one Markdown file per note, from the existing Google sign-in (drive.file), on a tap

files.note: the sheet: replace the notes-specific lines (the note fields, the space) for the app's own records

html: the #drive dialog in app/index.html and a button that opens it from Settings
needs: enable the Google Drive API for the app's Firebase project — https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/library/drive.googleapis.com
docs: Settings → Google Drive → Allow, then Sync now. Files land in Notes/<space>/ in the person's Drive; sync never deletes a file. Keep the CSP connect-src allowing https://*.googleapis.com.

drive also needs the app's merge3 (app/src/notes/merge3.js) for the 3-way line merge (a copy of the same file works) and a sign-in with Google (the Firebase Google provider; no Google script, no extra client id).
